description: A photograph depicting an extensive, sparsely vegetated landscape under the warm, low light of sunrise or sunset. The foreground and mid-ground feature rocky terrain, scattered low scrub, sparse grasses, and patches of bare earth, consistent with the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) definition of "sparsely vegetated areas," which have less than 50% field cover. A tall, dark signpost with a distinct 'X' shape at its top stands prominently on the left side of the frame. In the middle distance, a conical mountain peak rises clearly from the terrain, and further beyond, a dark, low-lying area possibly indicates forest or denser vegetation before the distant horizon. Small patches of residual snow are visible on the upper slopes to the far right.
